notes: This portable C++ TCK slice exercises the standard MIM HLArequestObjectInstanceInformation/HLAreportObjectInstanceInformation path for an owned object, a known object with no requester-owned attributes, and the NULL response after Local Delete Object Instance. The test uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, public handle decoders, HLAoctet/HLAvariableArray, and the C++ standard library. Provider package, FOM, object-class and attribute names, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation come from the adapter. It avoids private handle codecs, provider headers, registries, and vendor-specific names.

api_surfaces.owner: IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and IEEE 1516.2 standard MIM
api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object registration, publication, subscription, local deletion, public handle decoding, and standard federate MOM request/report interaction services
api_surfaces.source_symbol: RTIambassador object-management, interaction-management, callback, handle-decoding, and MIM declarations; FederateAmbassador::discoverObjectInstance and receiveInteraction
